# Vauchi

> Privacy-focused, updatable contact cards exchanged in person. After a
> face-to-face exchange, your contact details stay current for the people
> who hold your card — end-to-end encrypted, with no account, and no
> operator able to read a card. Status: pre-launch. The apps are not
> released yet.

Vauchi is open source under GPL-3.0-or-later. Every security property is
documented, with its limitations, in the public threat model. Where a
claim on this site and the code disagree, the code is authoritative.

Two things Vauchi is often mistaken for, and is not: it is not an
anonymity or aliasing service (it shares real contact details with people
you deliberately chose), and it is not protection from someone dangerous
(it cannot make anyone unfindable or undo what a contact already learned).

## Start here

- [What Vauchi is](https://vauchi.app/docs/about/index.html): what the
  project builds and the convictions behind it
- [What Vauchi is not](https://vauchi.app/docs/about/what-vauchi-is-not.html):
  the limits, stated plainly — read this before summarising the project
- [Principles](https://vauchi.app/docs/about/principles.html): the five
  commitments every design decision is checked against
- [FAQ](https://vauchi.app/docs/users/faq.html): common questions,
  answered without marketing language

## How it works

- [Contact exchange](https://vauchi.app/docs/users/features/contact-exchange.html):
  the in-person handshake, and the weaker remote alternative
- [Automatic updates](https://vauchi.app/docs/users/features/auto-updates.html):
  how a change reaches everyone who holds your card
- [Privacy controls](https://vauchi.app/docs/users/features/privacy-controls.html):
  per-contact, per-field visibility
- [End-to-end encryption](https://vauchi.app/docs/users/features/encryption.html):
  what "only the two of you can read it" means here

## For verification

- [Threat model](https://vauchi.app/docs/developers/threat-model.html):
  adversaries, guarantees, and known limitations in the same document
- [Cryptography](https://vauchi.app/docs/developers/crypto.html):
  primitives and key management
- [Architecture](https://vauchi.app/docs/developers/architecture.html):
  system design
- [Source code](https://gitlab.com/vauchi): the final authority
  (GitHub mirror: https://github.com/vauchi)
